title: Run three genuine Flyway native SQL layouts on the Spring Boot parent
description: Build a separate GraalVM executable for each root, nested, and two-directory SQL resource using the original Spring Boot parent JAR. Start a fresh H2 database for every executable and read the applied version, checksum and durable marker through independent JDBC. Repeat the JVM and Spring AOT controls before each image.

steps.name: Build and launch all three original native images
